Who we are

Rooted in faith.
Led by community.

The Justice Development and Peace Initiative of the Catholic Diocese of Maiduguri has served poor and marginalised communities since 1971. Our work brings humanitarian support, peacebuilding and sustainable development together—responding to urgent needs while helping communities shape their own future.

JusticeUpholding rights and human dignity.
DevelopmentBuilding resilient, sustainable lives.
PeaceCreating space for dialogue and healing.

What we do

One mission.
Many pathways to dignity.

Our programmes work together—meeting immediate needs, strengthening local systems and helping communities build lasting resilience.

01

Peacebuilding & Social Cohesion

Dialogue, mediation and reconciliation across conflict-divided communities.

02

Food Security & Livelihoods

Skills, agricultural support, market links and sustainable income for vulnerable households.

03

Water, Sanitation & Hygiene

Clean water systems, safe sanitation and practical hygiene support for remote communities.

04

Nutrition & Protection

Integrated support that protects children and families and improves community nutrition.

05

Mental Health & Psychosocial Support

Counselling, safe spaces and community-led care for people affected by conflict.

06

Governance & Advocacy

Civic participation, policy engagement and stronger local civil-society organisations.

Why JDPI

Local presence.
Long-term commitment.

JDPI began as the Social Welfare Apostolate in 1971. Today, the organisation combines faith, evidence and community leadership to address the connected realities of conflict, poverty and displacement.
